brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Provide tidy, compartmentalized storage for sewing supplies (threads, needles, buttons, small tools)
requirements.evidence: Three connected cells (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) with bins: 2x full-depth 2-compartment bins (hex-bin-full-div2) + 1x full-depth 3-compartment bin (hex-bin-full-div3) giving 7 separate compartments for sorting. Connectors at 0,0|0,1 and 0,0|1,0 tie cluster together.

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell cluster for sewing organization: two 2-compartment bins and one 3-compartment bin provide 7 divided spaces for thread, bobbins, needles, buttons etc., with side connectors securing the cells. Mesh clash is clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
